chunks: Shihab asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who married a woman for one thousand dirhams, then paid it to her, and she gifted it back to him and said, “I desire you more,” then he divorced her before consummating with her.
He عليه السلام said: “He returns against her for five hundred dirhams.”

key_terms.بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ: with a dowry amount of one thousand dirhams
key_terms.فَأَدَّاهَا إِلَيْهَا: so he paid it over to her
key_terms.فَوَهَبَتْهَا لَهُ: then she gifted it back to him
key_terms.قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: before consummating the marriage with her
key_terms.يَرْجِعُ عَلَيْهَا: he may claim back from her

ai.seo_question: If a wife gifts her mahr back to her husband and he divorces her before consummation, how much may he reclaim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling regarding a dowry that was paid, then gifted back by the wife, followed by divorce before consummation. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام rules that the husband may reclaim five hundred dirhams, reflecting the legal effect of pre-consummation divorce on the mahr.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
about a man who married a woman with a dowry of one thousand dirhams. He paid her the dowry, and she gifted it back to him, saying, "I desire you more."
However, he divorced her before consummating the marriage.
Imam (as) replied: "He is entitled to reclaim five hundred dirhams from her."
